name: Inverted Border Generator
author: Teet Bergmann

sections.description: SVG-based tool for cutting corners and creating boxes with border radius. Includes aspect ratio handling to ensure the element inside a wrapper div takes the maximum size while maintaining inverted corners. Use the SVG method for responsive layouts.
sections.installation:
Either using the dashboard ‘Add Plugin’ feature to find, install and activate the plugin, or
1. Download and unzip the plugin
2. Upload the entire contents of inverted-border-generator to the /wp-contents/plugins directory.
3. Activate the plugin through the Plugins menu

short_description: SVG tool for creating boxes with inverted borders, radius corners, and aspect ratio support. Responsive with SVG-based layout.
